score_rationale: Strong willingness-to-pay driven by acute staffing crisis: 67% of dental practices nationwide struggling to find qualified dental hygienists and dentists as of 2026, creating urgent recruitment pain point for dental staffing agencies, practice owners, and DSOs (Dental Service Organizations). All 50 states plus DC maintain public dental hygienist registries via State Boards of Dentistry with downloadable or scrapable data including hygienist name, license number, status, issue/expiration dates, and city/state. Some states (Texas confirmed via search results) explicitly provide 'Licensee Lists' as downloadable files. Zero PII — all professional licensing data. Engineering lift is moderate: scrape or download from 51 state dental boards, deduplicate multi-state license holders, normalize practice settings (private practice, DSO, mobile hygiene, etc.) where indicated. No affordable flat-file competitor exists on Gumroad — dental staffing platforms sell only monthly subscriptions, not one-time data exports. Audience size is substantial: approximately 250,000-300,000 active dental hygienists nationwide (per BLS 2026 projections of 11% growth through 2026), creating a TAM of 5,000+ potential buyers (staffing agencies, DSOs, product vendors, CE providers). Score is 7 due to validated acute staffing crisis driving high willingness-to-pay, confirmed public data availability, absence of low-cost flat-file alternatives, and clear recruitment ROI (one placement = $2K-$10K fee vs. $79 database cost = 25×-125× ROI).
